name: Operation of the Rohonc Codex

VINIT.justification: Represents the pre-decipherment void where the manuscript exists but holds no resolved semantic state

TANCH.justification: Serves as the terminal anchor that contains the entire decipherment system and marks completion

AFWD.justification: Directed morphism advancing left-to-right across folio lines to propose phonetic mappings

AREV.justification: Contravariant descent reversing a failed hypothesis to re-examine earlier glyph sequences

CLINK.justification: Sequential composition linking individual characters into words and words into sentences

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-referential identity where the script pattern recognizes its own structural and stylistic rules

FSPLIT.justification: Co-multiplication branching a single undeciphered character into parallel phonetic and semantic candidate paths

FFUSE.justification: Multiplication reconstituting the original glyph exactly by fusing resolved candidate branches back into unified meaning

EVALT.justification: Affirmative evaluation state where a proposed cipher mapping aligns with linguistic constraints

EVALF.justification: Negative evaluation state where a proposed mapping violates syntactic or historical rules

ENGAGR.justification: Paradice state holding two contradictory but structurally valid interpretations simultaneously without resolution

IFIX.justification: ROM fixation permanently recording a confirmed translation or catalog entry in append-only archival space
